description: Before the Artifact tool publishes an HTML page whose content security policy names a loopback connect-src (a connected page that works only on this machine), denies the call and tells the model to keep it a local file; every other Artifact call passes.

hooks.command: sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/prerequisites.sh" node-notice /review:check CONNECTED_PAGE_GUARD_ENABLED; ${PPID:+exit}; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/prerequisites.ps1" node-notice /review:check CONNECTED_PAGE_GUARD_ENABLED
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that node is on PATH...
Checking the page is not a connected page...
